newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech Corp Q3 net, revenues rise. [corrected 14:52 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Ameritech Corp Q3 net, revenues rise. [corrected 14:52 gmt]

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
(Corrects net and revenue figures to billions, from millions.)

NOTE: 1995 results include $10 million pretax gain ($7 million after-tax or $0.01/share) from lump-sum pension payments, and $66 million pretax gain ($41 million after-tax or $0.07/share) from exchange of minority interests in certain cellular partnerships. Q3 EPS before one-time items was $0.84.
(All data in 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Income before one-time items in the first nine months of 1995 was $1.39 billion. Earnings before one-time items were $2.51 per share in the first nine months of 1995.
NOTE: According to First Call, the consensus of analysts' estimates for 1996 third quarter earnings was $0.94 a share.
